pipeline.modality: Lipid nano-crystal (LNC) oral formulation of amphotericin B (small molecule, polyene antifungal)

indications.indication: Invasive aspergillosis (with limited or no treatment options)
indications.trial_design: Single Phase 3 registrational study; design not finalized at filing.
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — clinical development paused following October 2024 termination of partnership negotiations and 80% workforce reduction; IND remains active; company seeking partner to advance into Phase 3.
key_milestones: Oct 2024: MAT2203 partnership term sheet terminated; clinical development paused.
Company evaluating sale/license/strategic alternatives for MAT2203.

indications.trial_name: EnACT-3 (Encochleated Oral Amphotericin for Cryptococcal Meningitis Trial 3)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 trial; intervention arms MAT2203 vs IV amphotericin B; collaborator University of Minnesota.
indications.trial_status: UNKNOWN per ctgov (last update prior to development pause); positive Phase 2 EnACT (NCT04031833) met primary endpoint and demonstrated robust survival.
key_milestones: EnACT Phase 2 (NCT04031833): primary endpoint met, robust survival.
Phase 3 registration enabling per 10-K narrative; clinical activity paused.

pipeline.modality: Prescription omega-3 fatty acid composition (EPA + DPA)

indications.trial_design: Originally a Phase 3 study (NCT04662528) of MAT9001 vs placebo in severe hypertriglyceridemia; WITHDRAWN before initiation.
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — Phase 3 study withdrawn (NCT04662528, WITHDRAWN); company has initiated process to identify a partner to continue LYPDISO development.
key_milestones: Phase 2 PD study NCT04177680 completed Nov 2020.
FDA conditionally accepted LYPDISO brand name (Jan 2021).
Company seeking external partner for further development.

excluded_preclinical: Discovery programs in oncology and inflammation (LNC platform) — no IND filed.
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT03187691 (Phase 2 antifungal prophylaxis in AML/ALL, MAT2203) — WITHDRAWN.
NCT04031833 (Phase 1/2 EnACT, MAT2203) — COMPLETED, supports Phase 3.
NCT04177680 (Phase 2 omega-3 PD study, MAT9001) — COMPLETED.
NCT02310022 (Phase 1/2 omega-3 formulation PK/PD, MAT9001) — COMPLETED.

summary_counts.note: Both lead assets at Phase 3 stage but clinical activities paused; company in partner-seeking / strategic-alternatives mode.
